headwords: suy bụng ta ra bụng người

flags.why: This is formal administrative language, so leaving it untagged suggests it is suitable for ordinary casual speech.

The gloss presents general deterioration, whereas this verb refers to degradation during transformation, especially of energy ([dictionary](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-suy%20bi%E1%BA%BFn)).
flags.fix: to degrade during transformation (especially of energy)

flags.why: The environmental example uses suy biến as an ordinary word for environmental deterioration, which is unnatural here.
flags.fix: Năng lượng suy biến trong quá trình chuyển hóa. = Energy degrades during transformation.

flags.why: This word belongs to formal, academic discussion of reasoning rather than ordinary casual speech ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/suy-ly-ezQwLX6rqViSZ.html)).
The example explains the rank instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Viên suất thập dẫn lính đi tuần. = The squad leader led the soldiers on patrol.

flags.why: The example explains the rank instead of showing it in use.
flags.fix: Viên suất đội ra lệnh cho lính rút lui. = The officer ordered the soldiers to retreat.

flags.why: The common verb meaning used in expressions such as sát khuẩn tay is missing.
flags.fix: verb | to disinfect; to kill germs. Ex: Nhớ sát khuẩn tay trước khi vào phòng. = Remember to disinfect your hands before entering the room.
